description: A classless CSS stylesheet: link one file, write ordinary HTML, done. No build step, no dependencies, no JavaScript.
rules: Classless: style plain semantic HTML and do not add utility classes. If you are writing `class=` on every element, you are using it wrong.
Link one file — `fertig.css` (source) or `fertig.min.css` (minified). There is no build step and no dependencies.
Colors are OKLCH and all pairs meet WCAG AA contrast. The current ramps are gray, blue, cyan, green, amber, red and violet at 100/300/500/700/900; former palette names are not aliases.
Dark mode is automatic via `light-dark()` — do not add a theme toggle stylesheet on top of it.
Uses CSS logical properties, so RTL works without a separate stylesheet.
Do not use `<details>` as tabs. It is a disclosure widget. Use the ARIA tab pattern plus JavaScript for `aria-selected`, panel visibility, roving focus and arrow-key navigation.
